## About
Car Check is a locally owned and operated auto repair shop in Houston. Our mission is simple: honest, top quality repair done in a timely and professional way, from basic tune-ups to major transmission work.
Owner Ray Khalili lives in the area and looks after every job himself. He is an ASE Certified Technician and a graduate of the Auto Repair Technician program at Houston Community College. You're more likely to find him under a hood than behind the desk.
We work on cars, trucks, vans, SUVs, motorcycles and diesel vehicles, foreign and domestic. Neighbors have given us a 4.1 rating from 89 Google reviews.

## Services
- Brake repair: Brake repair and installation by technicians who specialize in brake systems.
- Tires, rims and wheels: New tires, rims and wheels for your car or truck, whether you need one or a full set.
- Alignments and balancing: Keep your car tracking straight and your tires wearing evenly.
- Shocks and struts: Shocks and struts for a smoother, steadier ride.
- Oil changes, tune-ups and maintenance: The everyday upkeep that keeps your vehicle reliable.
- Transmission and engine work: From transmission repairs to full engine replacements.
- Computer diagnostics: Computer diagnostics to find what's going on with your vehicle.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Cars, trucks, vans, SUVs, light trucks, motorcycles and diesel vehicles.

Q: Do you give estimates?
A: Yes. Give us a call for a free estimate.

Q: Do you offer roadside help?
A: Yes, we offer a roadside emergency assistance service. Call the shop and we'll help you out.

Q: Can I just stop by with a question?
A: You're welcome to come by the shop. We always have technicians around to talk with you and answer your questions.
